added: A program template can hold a slot rule: Add slot rule gives a slot a label, such as "Easy family opener", and one of your saved searches instead of one dance. A program made from the template starts with a placeholder there, showing the label and marked Placeholder.
Edit on a slot rule changes its label or its saved search. A rule can't be labelled Break, which marks a break.

Fill on a placeholder opens the dance picker with the rule's saved search already applied, and the dance you choose fills the slot. A placeholder saved unfilled stays one, on all your synced devices, and offers Fill with the same search later.

If a placeholder's saved search was deleted, can't be opened (saved by a newer version, or damaged), or uses a tag, level or venue that was deleted, Fill shows every dance with a notice saying which and naming what is gone; it never uses part of the search.
A saved search that a template's slot rule uses can't be deleted; the message names the rule and its template.
changed: A placeholder goes into a shared program, the programs CSV, the set list and the PDF as a plain note with its label; the saved search stays with you. Backups keep it, and a backup that holds one needs this version or later to restore.
data_migrations: Opening your library adds the place a placeholder keeps its saved search. Existing program slots are unchanged.

added: Add ProgramSlot.placeholderSearchId (program_slots.placeholder_search_id, schema v42) with isPlaceholder; the constructor drops it on a slot with a dance or when blank. It syncs as slots.placeholderSearchId, travels in backups, and is classified non-personal, app user, shareable in the field registry.
SavedSearchUse gains an optional detail, so a refusal can name where a use lives.
changed: The v41 to v42 step, and the check every open of a v42 file makes, add the nullable program_slots.placeholder_search_id column when it is missing; existing slots get NULL.
